title: Mortar Shell Explosion at Zawiya Security Camp Kills At Least Eight
detail: On the evening of October 18, 2026, an 82mm mortar shell exploded during a training exercise at a security camp in the Al-Harsha area of Zawiya, about 60 km west of Tripoli. Xinhua reported at least eight dead and eight injured; Libyan emergency services put the toll at nine. The camp is affiliated with the Security Threats Combatting Agency. A security source called it an accidental explosion; the cause has not been officially confirmed.

media.caption: At least 8 killed in mortar shell explosion in Libya

confidenceReason: Multiple outlets agree on the incident; toll varies (8-9) and cause unconfirmed. Media thumbnail is the article URL; no direct image was verified.
